family.ex: Please be punctual; the supplier meeting starts at nine.

syn.ex: Our reliability is why hospitals choose us.

syn.ex2: Reliability means on time, correct parts and a working UPS.

steps.ex: The engineer arrived on time for the commissioning.
steps.ex2: The client was happy we started on time.

syn.ex2: It's annoying, but it tells us the battery is weak.

syn.ex: Late deliveries are damaging to our reputation.
